biggest_catch: The $1M/day Spotlight fund is gone — the original Spotlight Rewards Program ended January 31, 2025, and the replacement is an invitation-only ad-revenue-share program that requires 50,000 followers plus millions of views (or 12,000 watch hours) in 28 days, with no published pay rates; meeting the numbers does not guarantee an invite.
catches: Snap confirmed the Spotlight Rewards Program ended on January 31, 2025 (announced Dec 16, 2024); the $1M/day daily payout fund from the 2020 launch no longer exists.
The replacement unified Monetization Program is by invitation — creators 'may be eligible for invitation' if they meet criteria, meaning the thresholds alone do not guarantee access.

Bar is high and raised: 50,000+ followers, 25+ posts per month to Saved Stories or Spotlight, posting on 10+ of the last 28 days, plus one of 10M Snap views / 1M Spotlight views / 12,000 hours view time in the last 28 days.
Spotlight videos must now be longer than 1 minute to earn; shorter clips earn nothing.
Payout is a variable share of ad revenue — Snap publishes no CPM, rate card, or concrete payout amounts in official terms; estimates are third-party only.
Fully AI-generated Spotlight content is now ineligible for monetization and recommendations (policy update July 2025).
Payment requires accumulating at least $100 (Crystals) before cashing out.

c1.evidence: Snap Inc. — real company; official announcement on newsroom.snap.com (Dec 16, 2024) and Snap's Creator Hub.

c2.evidence: No official terms page for a current public Spotlight payouts program — the original Spotlight Rewards Program ended January 31, 2025 per Snap's own announcement; the replacement is a unified invitation-only Monetization Program, not public terms.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to participate in either the historical or current program; failure is not on fees.

c4.evidence: No concrete payout in official terms — the unified program pays an undisclosed share of ad revenue (Snap publishes no rates or CPM); the historical $1M/day fund is defunct.

eligibility: The current unified Monetization Program (per Snap's Dec 16, 2024 announcement): invitation-only ('may be eligible for invitation'); 50,000+ followers; 25+ posts/month to Saved Stories or Spotlight; posting on 10+ of the last 28 days; and one of 10M Snap views, 1M Spotlight views, or 12,000 hours view time in the last 28 days; Spotlight videos must exceed 1 minute; 18+; eligible country; good standing. Meeting criteria does not guarantee an invite.
notes: Verified as REJECT 2026-09-22/23. Route R0479 is 'Snapchat Spotlight' — the creator fund that paid from the $1M/day pool. Snap ended the Spotlight Rewards Program on January 31, 2025 (confirmed to TechCrunch; announced on newsroom.snap.com) and replaced it Feb 1, 2025 with a unified Monetization Program paying ad revenue share across Stories and Spotlight videos over 1 minute. The replacement is invitation-only with no concrete published payout in official terms, so it fails the concrete-payout checklist (c2/c4). Gig-style catches apply: no guaranteed selection, performance-based variable pay, program can change or end at any time (as it already did). Rejection logged; do not re-verify until Snap publishes a public Spotlight program with concrete payout terms.
